# Can a fork PR's artifact get executed by your privileged workflow?

> Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find a workflow_run job that downloads an artifact and later executes something from it, plus a download-artifact step with no name: pin. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
